content.what_it_is: Fortran boundary/halo module comprising five external subroutines. BOUNDARY_CONDITION sets physical-edge hydrostatic fluxes and land-mask-adjacent fluxes (L56-L196); EXCHANGE_DISPERSION dispatches derivative and time-dispersion arrays to PHI_COLL with staggering codes (L205-L282); EXCHANGE exchanges state/mask fields and remasks velocities/transports (L292-L354); PHI_COLL_VARIABLE_LENGTH reflects P/Q ghost cells at physical boundaries (L365-L414); PHI_COLL performs periodic y exchange, VTYPE-specific reflection/zero conditions, and a final general halo exchange (L427-L783).
entities: SUBROUTINE PHI_COLL @L427; dummies VTYPE @L434, dimensions @L435, PHI @L436, PERIODIC @L437; req,nreq,len,ll,l,II,JJ,status,xx,send2d,myvar,mybeta @L438-L442

params_defined.name: VTYPE
params_defined.range: 1 symmetric scalar; 2 x-antisymmetric/u; 3 y-antisymmetric/v; 4 zero cross-derivative; 5 symmetric; 6 antisymmetric

params_defined.name: Nghost
params_defined.range: positive halo width constrained by array bounds

south periodic slab on north processor
north periodic slab to south processor

calls: PHI_COLL @L211-L277 from EXCHANGE_DISPERSION and @L299-L340 from EXCHANGE
PHI_COLL_VARIABLE_LENGTH for staggered P and Q @L324-L325
unresolved: Halo-exchange interface gap across L324-L325,L365-L414,L781: EXCHANGE sends staggered P/Q through PHI_COLL_VARIABLE_LENGTH, but that routine only reflects physical-edge ghosts and returns without any MPI/phi_exch call; ordinary PHI_COLL always finishes with phi_exch. Unless another caller-owned exchange exists, P/Q internal-processor halos remain stale when these fields are enabled.

Periodic overwrite defect across L445-L504 and L664-L779: PHI_COLL fills periodic y ghosts first, and VTYPE 1/2/3 protect later y boundary logic with .NOT.PERIODIC (e.g. L643), but VTYPE 4/5/6 south/north blocks have no such guard. On periodic end ranks they can overwrite periodic data with zero, symmetric, or antisymmetric physical-boundary values before phi_exch.

Boundary-condition halo-range dependency in L120-L194: loops already span Ibeg-1:Iend+1 and Jbeg-1:Jend+1, then access MASK(I-1,J), MASK(I+1,J), MASK(I,J-1), MASK(I,J+1) and P/F/G at I+1 or J+1. Correctness requires at least two addressable halo layers at extremes; this file neither asserts Nghost>=2 nor bounds-checks those accesses.
PHI_COLL accepts any integer VTYPE (L434) but has no else/error branch outside 1..6; an invalid code silently skips physical-boundary semantics and still calls phi_exch at L781.
